Name: Altro's Blacksmithing Overhaul for Content Patcher
Author: altroquinine
Description:
[i]Edit 1/25/25: I know the geode crusher is still not working as intended with certain things. I'm currently in my last semester of college and have been incredibly busy, so I haven't touched this mod in a long time. As of right now, this mod and all my others are on hiatus. If you wish to edit the code and fix the bugs yourself, then you are more than welcome to. My only request is that you don't claim the entire thing as your own. I was really hoping the CP update would fix the bugs but that was a bit of a pipe dream. I'm sorry I can't do more right now.[/i]

Have you ever wanted to reverse transmute your iridium and gold bars back into copper and iron? Have you ever wanted to exchange bars for ores so you can craft more bombs? Have you ever wanted to break open troves, coconuts, and mystery boxes in the geode crusher? Do you hate Clint and want him to be completely obsolete outside of tool upgrades? Well look no further!

This overhaul mod includes the ability to:
[list]
[*]Transmute [color=#ffd966]gold [/color]--> [color=#b4a7d6]iridium [/color]and [color=#b4a7d6]iridium [/color]--> [color=#b6d7a8]radioactive [/color]bars
[*]Reverse transmute [color=#b6d7a8]radioactive [/color]bars --> [color=#b4a7d6]iridium[/color], [color=#b4a7d6]iridium [/color]--> [color=#ffd966]gold[/color], [color=#ffd966]gold [/color]--> [color=#cfe2f3]iron[/color], [color=#cfe2f3]iron [/color]--> [color=#f9cb9c]copper[/color]
[*]Customize the amount of bars needed for the transmutation recipes
[*]Change which skill levels you receive the transmute recipes at
[*]Exchange your bars for ores at Clint's
[*]Allows Clint to sell [color=#b4a7d6]iridium [/color]and [color=#b6d7a8]radioactive [/color]ore
[*]Allows you to crush your metal bars in the geode crusher to get back ores
[*]Allows you to crush [color=#ffe599]artifact troves[/color], [color=#ffd966]golden coconuts[/color], [color=#6fa8dc]mystery boxes[/color], and [color=#ffd966]golden mystery boxes[/color][color=#f1c232] [/color]in the geode crusher
[/list]
Future plans/currently working on:
[list]
[*]Adding the Transmute (U) and Reverse Transmute (Ir) recipe to Qi's shop
[*]Allowing the dwarf to sell you ores, coal, and metal bars (similar to Krobus, they'd be on a rotating schedule)
[*]Allowing the dwarf to upgrade your tools (maybe after reaching 2 hearts?)
[*]Allowing you to buy the geode crusher recipe from the dwarf
[*]Adding Transmute and Revers Transmute recipes for quartz and fire quartz
[/list]
[b]BUGS:
[/b][list]
[*][b]The geode crusher cannot output things like hats, rings, etc. that you can usually receive when crushing at Clint's. This is a known bug in Stardew 1.6.8 and will be patched in 1.6.9. The current code should theoretically work once the update drops but I will be testing to make sure it doesn't need edits.[/b]
[*][b]If you have already completed Danger in the Deep or Skull Cavern Invasion prior to downloading this mod, you will have to complete them again to receive the Transmute (U) and Reverse Transmute (Ir) recipes. I am [color=#e06666]currently working[/color] on a way to stock them in Qi's shop for a small fee - they would only show up if you've completed the quest.[/b]
[/list]
